title: Richard Dolan: men in black as NHI counterintelligence
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Richard Dolan: men in black as NHI counterintelligence, about 1990s at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the view of a UFO researcher named Richard Dolan about the "men in black", the strange visitors who in UFO stories call on witnesses after a sighting. According to Michels, Dolan thinks they may be counterintelligence, meaning spying and cover work, carried out on behalf of non-human intelligence, the aliens themselves, rather than any human government. If true, it would mean the beings run their own secrecy operation among us.
